summary: Globant S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing a new share repurchase program authorizing up to $50 million per quarter, with a maximum aggregate of $125 million, to run from Q2 2026 through Q4 2027. The prior $125 million program was completed on April 6, 2026. Repurchases may be made via open market or accelerated share repurchases at management's discretion, subject to market conditions, regulatory requirements, and corporate liquidity. There is no obligation to repurchase any specific amount, and the program may be suspended anytime. The filing also includes Q1 2026 earnings results and disclosure of a securities class action filed on April 24, 2026, which the company disputes. Watch for pace of repurchases and any impact from the litigation on execution.
